title: Lior and the Uniform
author: Elodie Fairweather
blurb: Sable Ishikawa, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
